{{DISPLAYTITLE:ML_EMPPOT_RCUT}}
{{TAGDEF|ML_EMPPOT_RCUT|[real]|0.0}}

Description: Sets the cutoff radius for the empirical potentials.
----
The empirical potentials have a separate neighbor list. {{TAG|ML_EMPPOT_RCUT}} not only determines the cutoffs of the empirical potential functions but also the cutoff of the neighbor list.
